messages:
maria-cs: Heads-up — Acme (acct acme-88) reporting rerank returns all zeros for scores. They say it only happens when their documents include a nested "query" field. Repro + curl below. Request id: r-0a1b2c3d. Any quick ideas?

alex-api: can you paste the payload they used? curious if they accidentally put the user query inside each doc.

maria-cs: pasted from customer (redacted ids):
```
POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "query": "what's the return policy",
  "candidates": [
    { "id": "d1", "text": "return window is 30 days", "query": "internal note: refund flow" },
    { "id": "d2", "text": "we accept returns within 14 days", "query": "note: old policy v1" }
  ]
}
```

maria-cs: customer says response looks like:
```json
{ "scores": [0,0], "error": null }
```
(no helpful error) :confused:

sam-ml: quick hypothesis — our reranker flattens input keys and top-level "query" is expected to be the user query. If candidate docs include a field named "query" it may be shadowing/overwriting during parsing, causing mismatch and effectively scoring against the wrong text (or empty query) -> zeros.

alex-api: do we have code path that merges candidate objects into a single keyspace prior to model encoding? tagging @sam-ml to confirm.

sam-ml: yup — legacy parser merges fields with precedence: candidate fields can override root when key names collide (we inherited from old batcher). That behavior is not great.

jamie-ops: logs for r-0a1b2c3d show a validation pass but then we call the encoder with query=="" (empty). I'll attach snippet from logs: ``query=null after merge``. Looks like empty string, not null error.

erin-cust: confirmed — we have internal tooling that stuffs metadata into docs and we accidentally use "query" as metadata key. We can rename on our side but we need a short-term workaround while you fix.

alex-api: short-term workaround options:
- rename inner key (e.g., "doc_query_note") on customer side
- send user query in a different field name if using a custom param (not ideal)
- add a wrapper: { "candidate_text": ..., "metadata": { "query": ... } } if client supports it

sam-ml: medium-term: we should change parser to namespace candidate fields under a reserved key so collisions can't clobber root-level fields. I'll open an ENG issue and mark as P1 for parsing surprises.

jamie-ops: customer asked if there's a header they can flip. No header will fix shadowing. But we can add a temporary server-side check that rejects requests where any candidate has key "query" and return 422 with a helpful message. That buys time. Thoughts?

maria-cs: customer would prefer 2 things: 1) immediate clear 422 + error text so they can detect and fix from client; 2) ETA on parser fix. Can we do both?

sam-ml: will file the change (parser namespacing) and follow up with ETA. For immediate, jamie-ops can we add request validation rule and a short error message: "candidate object contains reserved key \"query\" — move to metadata or rename"?

jamie-ops: yep, can roll a validator rule to staging in ~2 business days, prod in 4. I'll include log instrumentation to catch similar ones.

alex-api: assigned to sam-ml (eng) and jamie-ops (ops). maria, can you pass the workaround and ETA to Acme and ask them to rename the inner key for now? Also ask if they can share a minimal repro (we have their sample already) so we can add an automated test.

maria-cs: will do. sending copy: "Temporary workaround: rename the field inside your candidate/docs objects from \"query\" to something else (e.g., \"note\" or move it under \"metadata\"). We are adding server-side validation and a parser fix — ETA ~4 business days for validator, parser fix in follow-up.

deploy-bot: staging validator rule pushed to ci/test-suite (build b-712). Tests: rerank-validator:reject_reserved_candidate_keys ✅

alex-api: thanks team. I'll track ENG ticket and link this thread. Closing here after customer confirmation. :thumbsup:

maria-cs: Acme confirmed rename worked (they changed candidate key to "note") — scores returned as expected. Leaving open until validator is in prod.
